podcast.body: This single generated significant controversy due to its suggestive lyrics and music video, which was noted for having a "plot twist like in Game of Thrones." It was part of The Prodigy's album "The Fat of the Land," contributing to its notoriety and the genre's expansion. "Uno de sus singles, Smart My Beatchup, generó una gran controversia por su sugerente letra y video musical, el cual tiene un plot twist que en juego de tronos."
